page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-96-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It features 96 dedicated virtual CPUs and 744.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and local storage is specified as None.

The high memory allocation relative to the vCPU count positions this instance as a memory-dense resource. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a substantial memory footprint allows for the consolidation of large-scale workloads onto a single node, reducing the overhead associated with multi-node cluster management.

This server configuration is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and heavy virtualization workloads. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration indicates that data persistence relies on network-attached storage, and workloads requiring hardware-accelerated parallel processing are not supported.
